chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: حَمْدَوَيْهَ وَمُحَمَّدٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ الْأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامِ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh and Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Abi Ja'far al-Ahwal, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

chunks.arabic_text: مَا فَعَلَ ابْنُ الطَّيَّارِ؟ قُلْتُ: تَوَفِّيَ، فَقَالَ: رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ، أَدْخَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ الرَّحْمَةَ وَالنُّضْرَةَ، فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يُخَاصِمُ عَنَّا أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ

translations.en: What happened to Ibn al-Tayyar? I said: He died, so he said: May Allah have mercy on him, may Allah cause mercy and radiance to enter upon him, for he used to verbally defend us, the People of the House.

en.summary: The Imam (peace be upon him) inquires about the fate of Ibn al-Tayyar upon hearing of his death, expressing mercy for him because he was known to argue and defend the Ahl al-Bayt (People of the House) in debates.
en.seo_question: Who was Ibn al-Tayyar and why did the Imam show mercy for him?

key_terms.ابْنُ الطَّيَّار: Ibn al-Tayyar (a specific companion known for defending the Imams)
key_terms.أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ: The People of the House (Ahl al-Bayt)
